Guilt Free

Brand Identity · Mascot · Packaging · Store Branding

F&B · Frozen Yogurt

2024

The Brief

Sweet Made Healthy

Guilt Free needed a complete brand identity for a frozen yogurt concept — fun, playful, and approachable, while communicating a core message: you can enjoy sweet treats without the guilt.

Challenge

Create a brand that stands out in the F&B space — appealing to health-conscious consumers while still feeling indulgent, fun, and worth sharing on social media.

Solution

A complete visual system built around "ele" — a living logo mascot that becomes the face of the brand. Four flavor worlds with distinct color identities, and a full store application that brings the brand to life.

Brand Mascot

Meet ele —
The Face of Guilt Free

ele is more than a logo mark — it's a living character that spreads the Guilt Free spirit across every touchpoint.

Logo System

One Mark,
Infinite Expressions

The logo adapts its color across every flavor and background — maintaining a consistent, joyful character instantly recognized by customers.

Flavor Color System

4 Flavors,
